Body.Content:
Enable active Microsoft Entra users without Dataverse or Power Apps licenses as activity recipients. Created user records remain disabled and do not grant Dynamics 365 app access.

Documentation: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/add-unlicensed-users-activities

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/add-unlicensed-users-activities

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: October CY2026
